# Allowlist for ci-blob-size-guard.yml
#
# One shell glob per line. Anything matched here is permitted to exceed the
# 5 MiB per-file limit. '#' starts a comment; blank lines are ignored.
#
# Adding an entry is a deliberate, reviewable act. Before you add one, check
# that the file is not actually a build artifact:
#
#   - Installers, tester packages, proof kits, soak outputs, model weights,
#     media renders -> GitHub Release assets, or local disk referenced by
#     path + hash from a committed text log. NEVER a committed file.
#   - Git LFS is not an escape hatch. Objects pushed to LFS are permanent;
#     this repo already has 17.25 GB parked there from exactly that mistake.
#
# Format: <glob>    # YYYY-MM-DD reason
#
# Required, tracked offline manuals; ci-docs checks their source/artifact hashes.
# Both exceeded 5 MiB in main at 8c3ab70b before this refresh (PDF 7185565,
# DOCX 5627216 bytes). No installer, model pack, evidence kit or directory glob.
docs/USER-MANUAL.pdf   # 2026-10-04 required illustrated operator manual
docs/USER-MANUAL.docx  # 2026-10-04 required editable operator manual
